verses.text: Concerning Moab. Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, 'Woe to Nebo, for it has been destroyed; Kiriathaim has been put to shame, it has been captured; The lofty stronghold has been put to shame and shattered.
verses.textZh: 論摩押。萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神如此說：尼波有禍了！因變為荒場。基列亭蒙羞被攻取。米斯迦蒙羞被毀壞；

verses.text: 'There is praise for Moab no longer; In Heshbon they have devised calamity against her: 'Come and let us cut her off from [being] a nation!' You too, Madmen, will be silenced; The sword will follow after you.
verses.textZh: 摩押不再被稱讚。有人在希實本設計謀害他，說：來罷！我們將他剪除，不再成國。瑪得緬哪，你也必默默無聲；刀劍必追趕你。

verses.text: 'The sound of an outcry from Horonaim, 'Devastation and great destruction!'
verses.textZh: 從何羅念有喊荒涼大毀滅的哀聲：

verses.text: 'Moab is broken, Her little ones have sounded out a cry [of distress].
verses.textZh: 摩押毀滅了！他的孩童（或譯：家僮）發哀聲，使人聽見。

verses.text: 'For by the ascent of Luhith They will ascend with continual weeping; For at the descent of Horonaim They have heard the anguished cry of destruction.
verses.textZh: 人上魯希坡隨走隨哭，因為在何羅念的下坡聽見毀滅的哀聲。

verses.text: 'Flee, save your lives, That you may be like a juniper in the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 你們要奔逃，自救性命，獨自居住，好像曠野的杜松。

verses.text: 'For because of your trust in your own achievements and treasures, Even you yourself will be captured; And Chemosh will go off into exile Together with his priests and his princes.
verses.textZh: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的財寶必被攻取。基抹和屬他的祭司、首領也要一同被擄去。

verses.text: 'A destroyer will come to every city, So that no city will escape; The valley also will be ruined And the plateau will be destroyed, As the LORD has said.
verses.textZh: 行毀滅的必來到各城，並無一城得免。山谷必致敗落，平原必被毀壞；正如耶和華所說的。

verses.text: 'Give wings to Moab, For she will flee away; And her cities will become a desolation, Without inhabitants in them.
verses.textZh: 要將翅膀給摩押，使他可以飛去。他的城邑必致荒涼，無人居住。

verses.text: 'Cursed be the one who does the LORD'S work negligently, And cursed be the one who restrains his sword from blood.
verses.textZh: （懶惰為耶和華行事的，必受咒詛；禁止刀劍不經血的，必受咒詛。）

verses.text: 'Moab has been at ease since his youth; He has also been undisturbed, [like wine] on its dregs, And he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, Nor has he gone into exile. Therefore he retains his flavor, And his aroma has not changed.
verses.textZh: 摩押自幼年以來常享安逸，如酒在渣滓上澄清，沒有從這器皿倒在那器皿裡，也未曾被擄去。因此，他的原味尚存，香氣未變。

verses.text: 'Therefore behold, the days are coming,' declares the LORD, 'when I will send to him those who tip [vessels], and they will tip him over, and they will empty his vessels and shatter his jars.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：日子將到，我必打發倒酒的往他那裡去，將他倒出來，倒空他的器皿，打碎他的罈子。

verses.text: 'And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
verses.textZh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家從前倚靠伯特利的神羞愧一樣。

verses.text: 'How can you say, 'We are mighty warriors, And men valiant for battle '?
verses.textZh: 你們怎麼說：我們是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？

verses.text: 'Moab has been destroyed and men have gone up to his cities; His choicest young men have also gone down to the slaughter,' Declares the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.textZh: 摩押變為荒場，敵人上去進了他的城邑。他所特選的少年人下去遭了殺戮；這是君王─名為萬軍之耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'The disaster of Moab will soon come, And his calamity has swiftly hastened.
verses.textZh: 摩押的災殃臨近；他的苦難速速來到。

verses.text: 'Mourn for him, all you who [live] around him, Even all of you who know his name; Say, 'How has the mighty scepter been broken, A staff of splendor!'
verses.textZh: 凡在他四圍的和認識他名的，你們都要為他悲傷，說：那結實的杖和那美好的棍，何竟折斷了呢？

verses.text: 'Come down from your glory And sit on the parched ground, O daughter dwelling in Dibon, For the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, He has ruined your strongholds.
verses.textZh: 住在底本的民哪（原文是女子），要從你榮耀的位上下來，坐受乾渴；因毀滅摩押的上來攻擊你，毀壞了你的保障。

verses.text: 'Stand by the road and keep watch, O inhabitant of Aroer; Ask him who flees and her who escapes [And] say, 'What has happened?'
verses.textZh: 住亞羅珥的啊，要站在道旁觀望，問逃避的男人和逃脫的女人說：是甚麼事呢？

verses.text: 'Moab has been put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out; Declare by the Arnon That Moab has been destroyed.
verses.textZh: 摩押因毀壞蒙羞；你們要哀號呼喊，要在亞嫩旁報告說：摩押變為荒場！

verses.text: 'Judgment has also come upon the plain, upon Holon, Jahzah and against Mephaath,
verses.textZh: 刑罰臨到平原之地的何倫、雅雜、米法押、

verses.text: against Dibon, Nebo and Beth-diblathaim,
verses.textZh: 底本、尼波、伯•低比拉太音、

verses.text: against Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul and Beth-meon,
verses.textZh: 基列亭、伯迦末、伯•米恩、

verses.text: against Kerioth, Bozrah and all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.
verses.textZh: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地遠近所有的城邑。

verses.text: 'The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm broken,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 摩押的角砍斷了，摩押的膀臂折斷了。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'Make him drunk, for he has become arrogant toward the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will become a laughingstock.
verses.textZh: 你們要使摩押沉醉，因他向耶和華誇大。他要在自己所吐之中打滾，又要被人嗤笑。

verses.text: 'Now was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Or was he caught among thieves? For each time you speak about him you shake [your head in scorn].
verses.textZh: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列麼？他豈是在賊中查出來的呢？你每逢提到他便搖頭。

verses.text: 'Leave the cities and dwell among the crags, O inhabitants of Moab, And be like a dove that nests Beyond the mouth of the chasm.
verses.textZh: 摩押的居民哪，要離開城邑，住在山崖裡，像鴿子在深淵口上搭窩。

verses.text: 'We have heard of the pride of Moab-- he [is] very proud-- Of his haughtiness, his pride, his arrogance and his self-exaltation.
verses.textZh: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲，是極其驕傲；聽說他自高自傲，並且狂妄，居心自大。

verses.text: 'I know his fury,' declares the LORD, 'But it is futile; His idle boasts have accomplished nothing.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：我知道他的忿怒是虛空的；他誇大的話一無所成。

verses.text: 'Therefore I will wail for Moab, Even for all Moab will I cry out; I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
verses.textZh: 因此，我要為摩押哀號，為摩押全地呼喊；人必為吉珥•哈列設人歎息。

verses.text: 'More than the weeping for Jazer I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils stretched across the sea, They reached to the sea of Jazer; Upon your summer fruits and your grape harvest The destroyer has fallen.
verses.textZh: 西比瑪的葡萄樹啊，我為你哀哭，甚於雅謝人哀哭。你的枝子蔓延過海，直長到雅謝海。那行毀滅的已經臨到你夏天的果子和你所摘的葡萄。

verses.text: 'So gladness and joy are taken away From the fruitful field, even from the land of Moab. And I have made the wine to cease from the wine presses; No one will tread [them] with shouting, The shouting will not be shouts [of joy].
verses.textZh: 肥田和摩押地的歡喜快樂都被奪去；我使酒醡的酒絕流，無人踹酒歡呼；那歡呼卻變為仇敵的吶喊（原文是那歡呼卻不是歡呼）。

verses.text: 'From the outcry at Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have raised their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim [and to] Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim will become desolate.
verses.textZh: 希實本人發的哀聲達到以利亞利，直達到雅雜；從瑣珥達到何羅念，直到伊基拉施利施亞，因為寧林的水必然乾涸。

verses.text: 'I will make an end of Moab,' declares the LORD, 'the one who offers [sacrifice] on the high place and the one who burns incense to his gods.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：我必在摩押地使那在邱壇獻祭的，和那向他的神燒香的都斷絕了。

verses.text: 'Therefore My heart wails for Moab like flutes; My heart also wails like flutes for the men of Kir-heres. Therefore they have lost the abundance it produced.
verses.textZh: 我心腹為摩押哀鳴如簫，我心腸為吉珥•哈列設人也是如此，因摩押人所得的財物都滅沒了。

verses.text: 'For every head is bald and every beard cut short; there are gashes on all the hands and sackcloth on the loins.
verses.textZh: 各人頭上光禿，鬍鬚剪短，手有劃傷，腰束麻布。

verses.text: 'On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like an undesirable vessel,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 在摩押的各房頂上和街市上處處有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎無人喜悅的器皿。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'How shattered it is! [How] they have wailed! How Moab has turned his back-- he is ashamed! So Moab will become a laughingstock and an object of terror to all around him.'
verses.textZh: 摩押何等毀壞！何等哀號！何等羞愧轉背！這樣，摩押必令四圍的人嗤笑驚駭。

verses.text: For thus says the LORD: 'Behold, one will fly swiftly like an eagle And spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：仇敵必如大鷹飛起，展開翅膀，攻擊摩押。

verses.text: 'Kerioth has been captured And the strongholds have been seized, So the hearts of the mighty men of Moab in that day Will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textZh: 加略被攻取，保障也被佔據。到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如臨產的婦人。

verses.text: 'Moab will be destroyed from [being] a people Because he has become arrogant toward the LORD.
verses.textZh: 摩押必被毀滅，不再成國，因他向耶和華誇大。

verses.text: 'Terror, pit and snare are [coming] upon you, O inhabitant of Moab,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：摩押的居民哪，恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。

verses.text: 'The one who flees from the terror Will fall into the pit, And the one who climbs up out of the pit Will be caught in the snare; For I shall bring upon her, [even] upon Moab, The year of their punishment,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 躲避恐懼的必墜入陷坑；從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住；因我必使追討之年臨到摩押。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'In the shadow of Heshbon The fugitives stand without strength; For a fire has gone forth from Heshbon And a flame from the midst of Sihon, And it has devoured the forehead of Moab And the scalps of the riotous revelers.
verses.textZh: 躲避的人無力站在希實本的影下；因為有火從希實本發出，有火燄出於西宏的城，燒盡摩押的角和鬨嚷人的頭頂。

verses.text: 'Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; For your sons have been taken away captive And your daughters into captivity.
verses.textZh: 摩押啊，你有禍了！屬基抹的民滅亡了！因你的眾子都被擄去，你的眾女也被擄去。

verses.text: 'Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab In the latter days,' declares the LORD. Thus far the judgment on Moab.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：到末後，我還要使被擄的摩押人歸回。摩押受審判的話到此為止。
